# Test start-up changes after a long power-off, not a quick restart

RAM kept across a short power-off can still hold code a start has not loaded yet, which hides load-order faults.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)

On the E-PM2 a start within about 30 s of power-off still found segment 2 in RAM from the last start; after 45 to 60 s off it had decayed. The project's test sheets now include starts after 2 minutes off and with the battery out. Its emulator could not show the fault, because it has no live view and copies segments in about 1 ms.

> **What happens:** Slow or failed cold starts that quick restarts and the emulator never show. On the E-PM2, about 10 s until the camera can shoot, inferred to pass through a hidden restart.

**Symptoms:** [Starts slowly](index.md#slow-start); [Fails to start, restarts or loops at power-on](index.md#start-failure)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)): The reporter and a contributor saw slow starts after 45 to 60 s off and fast ones after 10 s off. The owner's timed starts all kept RAM, even after more than 60 s off, and took about 2 s. Source: [EPM2Mod slow cold start investigation](../sources/epm2.slow-boot.md).
- **Emulator** ([EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)): Boots with RAM zeroed, filled with 0xFF, random or kept from an earlier run all started normally, stock and modded alike. Source: [EPM2Mod slow cold start investigation](../sources/epm2.slow-boot.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/cfu288/EPM2Mod/blob/3b6827892ed4f031a72acb7fec4496aaf9a29348/experiments/2026-11-24-slow-boot/NOTES.md)**
